dialogues.jp:
萌先輩に鍋をご馳走になり、図書室で本を返し
て教室に｛がいせん／凱旋｝する。
dialogues.en:
After sampling Moe's fantastic steampot feast, I
triumphantly returned the management room key to
Koyomi-sensei.
dialogues.text:
After sampling Moe's fantastic steampot feast, I
triumphantly returned the management room key to
Koyomi-sensei.

dialogues.jp:
半数以上の学生はすでに帰っていたが、教室に
は音夢も杉並もまだ残っていた。
dialogues.en:
I returned to the classroom, to find it half-empty. Nemu and
Suginami are about to leave too.
dialogues.text:
I returned to the classroom, to find it half-empty. Nemu and
Suginami are about to leave too.

dialogues.jp:
両手を上に上げて背筋を伸ばし、机の横にかかっ
ている鞄を手に取る。
dialogues.en:
Putting my hands above my head and stretching, I grab my bag
at the side of the desk.
dialogues.text:
Putting my hands above my head and stretching, I grab my bag
at the side of the desk.

dialogues.jp: 今日はどうしようかな。
dialogues.en: Who should I go home with today...
dialogues.text: Who should I go home with today...

dialogues.jp: 鍋も食って、図書室に本も返した。
dialogues.en:
After eating the pot feast, I returned the management room
key.
dialogues.text:
After eating the pot feast, I returned the management room
key.

dialogues.jp: 教室には杉並も音夢もまだ残っているな。
dialogues.en:
At the classroom, Suginami and Nemu are getting ready to
leave.
dialogues.text:
At the classroom, Suginami and Nemu are getting ready to
leave.

dialogues.en: Now, who should I go home with...
dialogues.text: Now, who should I go home with...
